i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load issue #383, parent #378, glossary, and the gold-cycle reporter/calibration code. Record pass when loaded.

q1-rootcause.title: What is the actual root cause of entity_count=None?
q1-rootcause.imperative: Locate the exact site where per-event entity_count is dropped. Recommended: the backtest scorer evaluate_labeled_batches never writes entity_count into per-event metrics; downstream event_metric_rows reads event.get('entity_count') or metrics.get('entity_count'), both absent -> None.

q2-fix-site.title: Where is the single canonical fix?
q2-fix-site.imperative: Decide whether to fix at the producer (backtest scorer) or patch the reporter. Recommended: fix at producer evaluate_labeled_batches so entity_count flows to ALL consumers (reporter, loso fusion rows, calibration) from one source — one canonical path per doctrine.

q3-entity-count-def.title: What exactly is entity_count?
q3-entity-count-def.imperative: Confirm the definition. Recommended: entity_count = len(batch.entity_ids) — the scored field size for that event — matching the independent definition already used in module_runtime.module_prediction_to_field_result diagnostics.

q4-positive-int-scope.title: Positive int for which events — scored only or all?
q4-positive-int-scope.imperative: Acceptance says positive int per scored event. Decide skipped-event behavior. Recommended: populate entity_count for every event the scorer produces a metrics row for (scored events have a real field); skipped events that never run the scorer keep None — assert positive int on scored events only.

q5-dof-evidence.title: How to demonstrate the dof term engages?
q5-dof-evidence.imperative: Acceptance requires confirming beta*effective_dof is non-constant across events. Recommended (per Admiral standing order): unit-level demonstration on the calibration objective/_effective_dof with realistic varying per-event entity counts, showing dof varies and the fitted beta term changes the objective; avoid a slow full gold cycle.

q6-schema-doc.title: Does this change the committed report schema?
q6-schema-doc.imperative: Decide whether schema/doc updates are required. Recommended: entity_count already exists in gold_report_schema.py and the generated schema doc (modules[].event_level_metrics[].entity_count). We populate an already-declared field; no shape change. Optionally tighten the field's nullable-behavior note for accuracy.

q7-sibling-boundary.title: Where is the boundary with sibling #384?
q7-sibling-boundary.imperative: #384 owns module_uncertainty_diagnostics key sets (_SIGMA_ERROR_CORR_KEYS reconciliation). Confirm this work stays on entity_count emission + calibration dof term and does not touch #384's key-set reconciliation. Recommended: stay strictly in the producer + reporter + calibration dof lane.

q8-placement.title: Row-level vs metrics-level entity_count placement
q8-placement.imperative: Decide whether entity_count goes in per-event metrics dict or row top-level. Recommended: row top-level (next to entity_ids), NOT in metrics, so _mean_metrics does not create a spurious aggregate_metrics.entity_count; all three downstream readers check event.get('entity_count') before metrics.get('entity_count').
